headline: Stock market midday, August 18: BUX and 4iG plunge, leading shares also in the red
summary: The BUX index fell to 148,760.47 points around noon on the Budapest Stock Exchange. OTP and Richter continued to decline, while 4iG and BUX shares were reported to plunge.
why: The BUX is the benchmark index of the Budapest Stock Exchange, tracking Hungary's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect sentiment toward Hungarian equities.
why_moved: The input reports broad declines on the Budapest Stock Exchange, with the BUX falling and major shares including OTP and Richter continuing to decline.
